name: Up Young Cornerstone Corp.
summary: Up Young Cornerstone Corp. specializes in the distribution of both commercial and residential laundry equipment. Their product range further encompasses a variety of household appliances, including kitchen essentials like refrigerators, dishwashers, and ovens, alongside energy-efficient inverter air conditioning units and automated ironing machines. The company also leverages e-commerce, operating online stores to make its products accessible to customers. Founded in 1968, Up Young Cornerstone Corp. maintains its headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
